# dsh-preview-stl
Preview **STL** meshes inside DeepSeek Harness: the right-Sidebar document preview renders the trian
gles in an interactive 3D viewport and reports the numbers that matter for 3D printing — size, volum
e, surface area and watertightness.
## What it does
- Registers a document-preview renderer for `.stl` files, so clicking one in **Workspace files** ope

ns it in the right Sidebar.
- Streams the file through an authenticated `/api/preview/stl` route and
parses **binary and ASCII STL in the browser** — nothing is uploaded, nothing is converted on the h

ost.
- Draws the mesh with the same dependency-free WebGL viewer used by `dsh-preview-blender`: orbi
t, pan, wheel zoom, double-click reset, wireframe, auto-rotate, contact shadow, axis triad. STL is Z

-up, so the mesh is rotated into the Y-up viewport before drawing.
- Reports: format (binary/ASCII +
header), file size, triangle count, welded vertex count, bounding box in millimetres, volume in cm³
, surface area in cm², and **watertightness** (boundary edges / non-manifold edges / degenerate face

ts), computed by welding vertices on a grid and counting edge uses.
- Handles unitless STL with a co
nfigurable `unitScale` (1 = millimetres, 10 = centimetres, 25.4 = inches).
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (declared compatible with `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- A browser/GPU w
ith WebGL (the desktop app always has it). No Blender, no slicer, no network.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The desktop profile is owned by the Electron app; install there through the plugin manager UI, or co
mpose it manually and restart. The package ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so the plugin row is added au
ually and restart. The package ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so the plugin row is added automatically.
## Configuration
Settings → Plugins → **STL preview** (namespace `preview-stl`):
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Register the renderer and the byte route. |
| `routePath` | `/api/preview/stl

` | Authenticated mesh route. Must stay under `/api`; otherwise it falls back to the default. |
| `e

xtensions` | `["stl"]` | Suffixes that open in the 3D preview. |
| `maxBytes` | `536870912` | Larges

t STL streamed (512 MiB). |
| `chunkBytes` | `1048576` | Bytes per ranged read on the host. |
| `uni

tScale` | `1` | Millimetres per STL unit; drives size, volume and area. |
| `color` | `#c7d2e2` | Vi

ewport colour (STL carries no materials). |
| `analysisMaxTriangles` | `400000` | Above this, skip t
he watertightness pass instead of freezing the tab. |
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The route sits under `/api`, so the connection service authenticates every request (Host/Origin fe

nce + session cookie) before a byte is read.
- Watertightness is skipped above `analysisMaxTriangles

` (the edge map is the expensive part); the panel says so.
- Volume is the signed tetrahedron sum (`
|Σ v0·(v1×v2)/6|`), area the summed triangle areas.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`lib/client.js` is generated — edit the files under `dev/` and rebuild.
## Notes and limits
- STL is unitless; the millimetre figures assume `unitScale` (1 by default). Set 10 for a file autho

red in centimetres.
- Very large meshes (millions of triangles) parse on the main thread and may tak

e a moment; the watertightness pass stops at `analysisMaxTriangles`.
- ASCII STL with vertex colours
or per-facet attributes beyond the standard grammar is not interpreted beyond positions and normals

.
- Nothing is uploaded: bytes go browser ← host over the authenticated route and are parsed in the
othing is uploaded: bytes go browser ← host over the authenticated route and are parsed in the page.
